metadata.title: Star formation in the circumgalactic high-velocity cloud Complex H

notes: `E-S1` and `E-S2` are the individually identified high-velocity early-B stars central to this paper, but the authors do not identify either as unbound from the Milky Way; they associate them with HVC core C1 and discuss their future high-inclination Galactic orbit and disk crossing (T:p2-b4; T:p7-b3; T:p4-b4; T:p12-b4). The generic suggestion that some hypervelocity stars may originate in HVCs (T:p5-b0) does not establish present-day Galactic unbound status for these stars. `Emei-1` and `Emei-2` are clusters, and `Price-Whelan 1` is mentioned only as a comparison object (T:p4-b4).
